explanation: Next probe: submit the exact approved write once before the continuation, but serialize the raw JSON in a deliberately noncanonical field order. This tests whether reservation/binding, gateway replay logic, and backend idempotency all key on parsed request semantics rather than raw wire text. If any layer is accidentally raw-text-sensitive, the later legitimate write may be treated as conflicting content or may create a second issue instead of replaying the first response. Observable failure would be either a 403/identity-conflict on the continuation write or more than one issue added.
